lines: A driver gets a new wave when 90% of what he offered has sold.
Growth phase: waves allowed down to -$1,000 per driver, limited by free cash.

sections.title: Tightening
lines: Backstop off. It stops a driver whose line falls under -$250.
Glide starts Sat 11:00am CT: limit slides from -$250 to +$100 by Sat 3:00pm CT.
Under the limit it trims rows, buys back cheaply, and sells to close gaps from Sat 1:30pm CT.
Even-up from Sat 3:00pm CT, last-resort take from Sat 2:40pm CT, green flag Sat 3:00pm CT.

sections.title: Will it adapt on its own?
lines: Mostly yes: waves, price steps and the glide run by rule. The worst line may not fully close.
